'''2001 Origins Constructed (7 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed (convention side event) held in Origins, Columbus, Ohio on 7 July 2001. It is known from David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2624">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-monteiro-goes-to-origins-2001d2624/ monteiro-goes-to-origins-2001], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 14 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-14-monteiro-goes-to-origins-2001d2624/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Origins Open]].

* '''Date:''' 7 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Origins, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
